sentences.text:
(Krishnachand Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh ) Dated : 08-07-2025 Shri Nitesh
Kumar Jain, Advocate for appellant.
Shri Nitin Gupta, Government Advocate for State.
Heard on I.A.No.21586/2024, which is second application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant Krishnachand S/o.Dulichand.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 27.11.2021 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act) Balaghat in Special Case SCATR/54/2018 convicting the appellant for the offence under Section 376(2) of the I.P.C read with Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
Section 506 Part-II of the IPC and Section 450 of the IPC and sentencing him to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life, rigorous imprisonment for three years and rigorous imprisonment for five years with fine of Rs.5,000/-, Rs.2,000/-, Rs.5,000/- and in default of payment of fine to undergo additional rigorous imprisonment for one year, rigorous imprisonment for one month and rigorous imprisonment for six months respectively.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail 2 CRA-7557-2021 till final disposal of this appeal.
Learned Government Advocate for the State on the other hand opposes the prayer made by learned counsel for the appellant and prays for dismissal of the aforesaid application.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that it is a fit case to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 17.9.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of Krishnachand vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91453116/
